title: DuckDB FROM and JOIN clauses: ASOF JOIN
bounded_claim: ASOF JOIN is a temporal/ordered nearest-match join with at least one inequality on the ordering field and optional equality predicates; it does not itself perform entity-identity adjudication.
use_limit: Independent implementation documentation supports operation decomposition and executable semantics but is not universal semantic authority.

title: NIST SP 800-162 Guide to Attribute Based Access Control
issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
bounded_claim: Authorization is an access-control decision over subject, object, requested operation and environment attributes evaluated against policy/rules/relationships; authorization is distinct from reading or materializing the authorized data.
use_limit: Supports authorization separation only; does not define source-cut materialization semantics.

title: JCGM 100:2008 Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
issuer: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology / BIPM
bounded_claim: Evaluation/expression of uncertainty is a distinct obligation attached to a result/model and requires an explicitly selected uncertainty evaluation relation; it is not synonymous with the estimator producing the central result.
use_limit: Measurement-uncertainty authority is broad but does not select a statistical estimator for every analytical domain.

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
bounded_claim: Provenance distinguishes entities, activities and agents and their generation/usage/derivation/responsibility relations; provenance/evidence can be attached to an output without becoming the decision or authorization itself.
use_limit: Supports provenance structure and non-collapse only; it does not define business decision authority.

title: Decision Model and Notation 1.5
bounded_claim: DMN Information Requirements represent input-data or prior-decision information flowing to a Decision; input/evidence and a decision remain distinct modeled elements.
use_limit: Supports information-to-decision non-collapse; it does not define execution authorization or realized business effects.

title: Grain - Kimball Dimensional Modeling Techniques
bounded_claim: Grain states exactly what a fact row represents; facts/dimensions must be consistent with that grain and different grains must not be silently mixed.
use_limit: Influential dimensional-modeling architecture evidence, not a universal mathematical standard; cross-grain transformations still require explicit algebra and loss laws.

title: ISO 31000:2018 Risk management — Guidelines
bounded_claim: ISO 31000 separates risk identification, analysis, evaluation, treatment, monitoring and communication within a risk-management process and is intended for organizations across sectors.
use_limit: Supports cross-industry lifecycle distinctions but does not establish one universal risk object ontology, scoring scale, treatment authority or vertical regulation. ISO states the 2018 edition remains current while revision work is underway.

title: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
bounded_claim: Risk assessment evaluates risk factors and provides information for determining courses of action; assessment is one part of a broader risk-management process rather than the treatment decision itself.
use_limit: Security/privacy risk-assessment guidance supports non-collapse and assessment structure; its threat/vulnerability vocabulary is not universalized to finance, safety, health, engineering or other risk domains.

title: Stress testing principles
bounded_claim: The current BCBS principles treat stress testing as a governed framework with objectives, governance, policies, processes, methodology, resources and documentation; scenarios follow risk identification and may include sensitivity, scenario and reverse-stress designs.
use_limit: Strong evidence for separating stress-test method/lifecycle semantics from a generic data transform. Banking-specific governance, capital/liquidity objectives and scenario requirements are not universal semantics for other industries.

title: Process Mining overview, discovery and conformance checking
bounded_claim: Process mining contains distinct method families including process discovery, conformance checking and performance analysis; an unqualified 'process mine' request therefore selects a method family, not one universal atomic operation.
use_limit: Independent academic/practice evidence supports method-family decomposition but does not replace the repository's semantic authority or exact OCEL/process-method contracts.
